ARCS kitMolecule 46day-list

Day List

Tell the reader what happens on each day of a short plan, one plain sentence per day, from Before to After.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1HeadingOne or two words (Your week), headline sizetext
2ListAn ordered list in one bordered box; rows split by a hairlinesurface, border, ds-r-sm
3Day4.5rem column, bold, tabular, no wrap; a screen-reader : follows ittext
4SentenceOne plain sentence, text-wrap:pretty; numbers keep a non-breaking hyphen (30‑minute)text

Usage

Use it when

  • A short plan (a week or two) where the reader wants the shape of it before the detail.
  • Pair each row with the item ids it covers (data-items) so the consuming page can cross-check the list against the full grid.

Do not use it when

  • Do not put more than one sentence on a day, or a status pill on a row; status lives in the status strip.
  • Do not use it for a plan over about ten days; use the full grid with the pinned details card instead.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
days[]{day, text, items?}yesday is the label (Before, Day 1, After); text is one sentence; items is an optional list of grid row ids for cross-checking.

Access

  • A labelled section (aria-labelledby the heading) holding an ol, so screen readers announce the count and order.
  • The day is followed by a visually hidden : , so it reads Day 1: then the sentence rather than running together.
  • Rem sizing; the day column is 4.5rem and holds Before at the largest text size.
